name: NVT SYMPHONY OF ORCHARDS
description: NVT Symphony of Orchards is a residential villa project approved under the Group Housing Scheme. The project comprises of 161 villas spread in 18.5 acres with world class specifications and unique designs promising abundant sunlight and ventilation. The project comes with amenities like Tennis Court, Gym, Swimming Pool, Children Play areas and lots of green spaces to meet the modern lifestyle.
